title: Peg Can Not Nap
lines: Peg got in bed at ten.
"Ted! A tan cap is not in the bed," said Peg.
Ted met Min at the bin.
Min and Ted got the bin up.
Min got the cap in the bin!
Ted got the cap to Peg.
scoring_note: This passage says "is not", "can not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "isn't" or "can't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
